opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for government tuition fee support, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish HEI for academic year 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Supports tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students, up to £1,820 per year, for courses at Scottish universities, colleges and designated institutions.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income Scottish residents with a place on a taught or research master’s programme beginning in 2026/27, ordinarily resident in Scotland.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support of up to £5,000 per year for eligible postgraduate master’s students to reduce the cost barrier of postgraduate study in Scotland.
